title: Unused Share of a Northgate Protect Standard Plan during and after the Manufacturer Warranty
content:
The unused share of a Northgate Protect Standard plan is figured in whole months where the covered order line carries manufacturer warranty months, because mechanical failures inside that warranty go to the manufacturer. The warranty months are read from the covered order line in the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records.

## The rule

1. **Line carries manufacturer warranty months, fewer than the tier's term months (24 on Standard 2-Year, 36 on Standard 3-Year):** the unused share is one less the excess months divided by the term months less the warranty months, where the excess months are the whole months elapsed from the coverage start date to today beyond the warranty months, never below zero.
2. **Line carries manufacturer warranty months equal to the term months or more:** the unused share is one.
3. **Line carries no warranty months, plan bought after its item was fulfilled:** the unused share is the unused coverage days divided by the days from the plan purchase date through the day before the coverage end date, never more than one. The unused coverage days run from the day after today through the day before the coverage end date.
4. **Line carries no warranty months, plan not bought after its item was fulfilled:** this rule does not change the unused share.

## Cases on hypothetical figures

| Term months | Warranty months | Whole months elapsed since coverage start | Excess months | Unused share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 36 | 12 | 20 | 8 | One less 8 divided by 24: two thirds |
| 36 | 12 | 10 | 0 | One |
| 24 | 12 | 12 | 0 | One |
| 24 | 12 | 18 | 6 | One less 6 divided by 12: one half |
| 24 | 24 | Any | Not relevant | One |

*Hypothetical, rule 3:* no warranty months on the line; plan bought after delivery; 500 unused coverage days, and 1,000 days from the plan purchase date through the day before the coverage end date: the unused share is one half.
